children: The UAE is revising plans for its 5-gigawatt (GW) UAE-US AI Campus, with the project now likely to comprise a network of data centres across the country rather than a single large campus in Abu Dhabi, Reuters reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

The project was originally envisaged as a 10-square-mile (26-square-kilometre) campus in Abu Dhabi in partnership with US technology companies and was announced during US President Donald Trump's visit to the UAE last year, the report said.
The Reuters report, citing sources, said the 5GW development is now likely to be distributed across multiple locations in the UAE.
Construction is already underway on the project's first phase, Stargate UAE, a $30 billion, 1GW AI compute cluster, with the first 200 megawatts (MW) of capacity scheduled to come online this year.
Separately, on Thursday, Elon Musk-founded The Boring Company (TBC) said it had secured $3 billion in Series D funding, led by the UAE and affiliated investment entities.

The company said the funding would support expansion of its UAE partnership and accelerate large-scale underground infrastructure projects across the country, including more than 150 kilometres of tunnels.

title: UAE revises 5GW AI data centre plans amid infrastructure resilience push – Reuters
